## Download

| You have | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and newer) | `Stokebay-…-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel processor | `Stokebay-…-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `Stokebay-… Setup.exe` |
| Ubuntu, Debian | `stokebay_…_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora, openSUSE | `Stokebay-….x86_64.rpm` |

## First launch

Stokebay isn't signed with a paid Apple or Microsoft certificate yet, so your computer asks once:

- **macOS:** open Stokebay, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click
  **Open Anyway** next to the Stokebay message.
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.

Your projects stay on your computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
